quote: const res = await fetch("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(lines) });
title: Send has no try/catch and no success feedback: offline gives silence, success gives silence
evidence: app.js:24-29. fetch rejects on network failure; there is no catch, so the handler dies with an unhandled rejection and the user sees nothing. On success only sentCount is incremented (line 28) and sentCount is never read or displayed; lines are not cleared. Traced.
failing_case: Go offline, add a line, click Send: no alert, no message; the user cannot tell whether the invoice went out. Online, click Send: also no visible change, so the user clicks again (see the double-send finding) or assumes it failed. Body is also a JSON string sent with no Content-Type header, so it goes as text/plain.
remediation: Wrap the call in try/catch, show a status message (in a role=status region) for sending, sent and failed with a cause and next step, set Content-Type: application/json, and clear or lock the lines after success.

title: Send guard is a 1-second timer, not an in-flight lock: a slow request can be sent twice
evidence: guards.js:21-26 records the click time and blocks only clicks inside 1000 ms. app.js:26 awaits fetch with no pending flag and the button is never disabled. Traced.
failing_case: Network takes 3 s. User clicks Send at t=0 (POST 1 starts), sees nothing happen, clicks again at t=1.5 s. tooSoon() returns false, POST 2 is sent with the same lines. The server receives two invoices. Also, lastSend is set before the request, so after a failed send the user is blocked for the rest of the second without being told why (silent return at app.js:25).
remediation: Hold an in-flight flag: disable the button until the request settles, and send an idempotency key with the invoice so the server drops a repeat.

title: Entered invoice lines live only in memory: refresh or close loses them
evidence: app.js:1 is the only store. There is no localStorage, no beforeunload warning, no pagehide flush. Traced.
failing_case: Enter 20 lines, accidentally refresh or press Back: the list and total are empty again with no warning.
remediation: Persist the draft with a version field and a guarded load, or warn on beforeunload while there are unsent lines.

quote: const total = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.qty * l.price, 0);
title: Money is summed as unrounded floats, so the displayed total and the sent amounts can disagree; Infinity is accepted as a price
evidence: Price is accepted with any number of decimals and any magnitude (app.js:18-19: Number(text) > 0). Each row is shown rounded with toFixed(2) (app.js:8) but the total sums the raw values and the raw floats are posted (app.js:26). Number('1e999') is Infinity, which passes `price > 0`, and the total then renders 'Infinity'. The money rule also lives inside render() (domain leak). Reasoned by hand; node could not be run in this review.
failing_case: Add three lines with quantity 1 and price 0.004. Each row displays '1 × 0.00', yet the total displays 0.01 (0.012 rounded) and 0.004 is what is posted for each. Add a line with price 1e999: the total shows 'Infinity' and JSON.stringify posts null for the price.
remediation: Parse prices to integer minor units, reject more than two decimals and non-finite values, and compute lines and totals in one pure, tested function; the view displays its result and the same integers are sent.

title: A client name of only spaces passes the required check and produces a blank line
evidence: index.html:14 uses required, which accepts '   '. app.js:16 trims to '' and nothing re-checks it before line 20 pushes. The rendered anchor (line 8) then has empty text. Traced.
failing_case: Enter spaces for Client, quantity 1, price 5, click Add line: the list shows an empty link followed by ': 1 × 5.00'. The invoice sent to the server holds client ''.
remediation: Reject an empty trimmed client with an inline error, and have the server reject it too.

title: Invalid quantity or price is rejected silently; Infinity and sub-cent prices pass
evidence: app.js:18-19. A failed check just returns: no message, no focus move, no aria-invalid. Number() accepts 'Infinity', '1e999' (Infinity), '0x10' (16) and '0.004', all > 0. Traced from JS number rules.
failing_case: Type quantity 'abc' or leave price blank and click Add line: nothing happens and the user does not know why. Type price 1e999: the line is pushed, total shows 'Infinity' and JSON.stringify sends null for the price. Price 0.004 with quantity 1000: the line shows '0.00' but the total includes 4.00.
remediation: Validate price as a decimal string with at most two places and a finite upper bound, show an inline error beside the field (linked with aria-describedby, aria-invalid set), and move focus to the first bad field.

title: Send with no lines posts an empty invoice
evidence: Nothing at app.js:24-26 checks lines.length. On first load `lines` is [] and the Send button is enabled (index.html:23).
failing_case: Open the page and click Send invoice immediately: POST /api/invoices with body '[]'. If the server accepts it, an empty invoice is created and the user sees nothing.
remediation: Disable Send until at least one valid line exists, and have the server reject empty invoices.

title: Void is destructive, has no confirmation, names no invoice, and reports nothing on success or network failure
evidence: app.js:31-35. No confirm step, no body or id identifying the invoice, no catch around fetch, no success message; only a non-ok status alerts. The button sits directly beside Send with the same style (index.html:23-24, styles.css:4). Traced.
failing_case: An admin who mis-clicks Void next to Send voids immediately with no undo. Offline, the click throws an unhandled rejection and nothing is shown. After a successful void, nothing on the page changes.
remediation: Send the invoice id, ask for confirmation naming the invoice, set an in-flight state, catch network errors, and show the voided result; style Void as secondary and separate it from Send.

title: Whole list is rewritten via innerHTML inside a live region, so every add re-announces every line
evidence: app.js:7 replaces list.innerHTML on each add; a polite live region on the replaced container announces the changed content, often the whole list. The failures of Add (silent invalid input) are not announced at all. Traced; no screen reader run.
failing_case: Screen-reader user adds the 15th line and hears all 15 lines read again; when the entry is invalid, nothing is announced.
remediation: Append only the new li (or keep the list non-live) and put a short message in a separate role=status region, such as 'Line added: Acme, 3 x 4.00'.

quote: const user = { name: "sam", roles: ["viewer", "billing"] };  // the signed-in user
title: Void permission is checked only in the browser, against a hard-coded user object
evidence: The only authorisation for voiding is canVoid(user) (app.js:32), a client function over a client-side object. The request at app.js:33 carries no identity or body. No server code is in the payload, so whether /api/invoices/void checks the role is unknown. The user is hard-coded, not read from a session.
failing_case: Any signed-in user opens the console and runs fetch('/api/invoices/void', {method:'POST'}), or runs user.roles.push('admin') and clicks the button. If the server does not itself require admin, a viewer voids an invoice.

requirement.why: guards.js:9 says 'Only admins may void an invoice', but the only enforcement in the payload is client-side.

remediation: Enforce the admin role in /api/invoices/void on the server from the session; use the client check only to hide the control, and load the user from the session.

title: Void invoice button is shown to a user who cannot void and does nothing when clicked
evidence: index.html:24 always renders the button. The signed-in user is {roles: [viewer, billing]} (app.js:2), so canVoid (guards.js:10-12) is false and the handler returns with no message, no disabled state, no tooltip. Traced.
failing_case: Signed in as sam (viewer, billing), click Void invoice: nothing visible happens, no explanation. A user who needs to void an invoice has no way to learn why or whom to ask.
remediation: Hide or disable the button (with aria-disabled and a stated reason) for users without the admin role, or show a message naming the missing permission.

title: Each client name is a link to '#' that goes nowhere
evidence: app.js:8 renders an anchor with href '#' and no handler anywhere in app.js. Escaping is correct (guards.js:4-7). Traced.
failing_case: Keyboard user tabs to each client name; Enter jumps to the page top and adds '#' to the URL. Each line is one extra useless tab stop.
remediation: Render plain text, or make it a real link to a client page.
